description: Read-only. Searches Dock's help center (the articles at trydock.ai/help) and returns matching articles: slug, title, summary and link. Use it before answering a question about how Dock works, then read_help_article for the full text. Every word in the query must appear in an article; if nothing matches, try fewer or different words.

limit.description: How many articles to return (1-10, default 5).

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. 'cloud agents' or 'cancel plan'. Up to 200 characters.

name: search_help
